description: Voyager's final year pushes the crew through Borg resistance, fractured timelines, questions of identity and the growing reality of life after the Delta Quadrant, while the possibility of reaching Earth shifts from distant hope to an immediate choice.

s07e01.description: Janeway, Tuvok and Torres remain assimilated aboard a Borg cube while their allies in Unimatrix Zero attempt to turn a hidden refuge into an organized resistance against the Collective.

s07e02.description: Seven's cortical implant begins failing after several Borg children leave Voyager, forcing the crew to search for a compatible replacement before her body shuts down.

s07e03.description: Paris and Torres enter the Delta Flyer in a high-speed interstellar race meant to promote peace, only to discover that someone intends to turn the competition into an act of sabotage.

s07e04.description: Former Maquis crew members are assaulted one by one, and Tuvok's investigation uncovers a hidden conditioning program connected to their old resistance movement.

s07e05.description: The Doctor is stolen and forced to work in a hospital where treatment is rationed by social status, pushing him to manipulate the system to save patients deemed expendable.

s07e06.description: A holographic Barclay reaches Voyager with a seemingly practical plan for getting home, but his instructions conceal a Ferengi scheme aimed at Seven's Borg technology.

s07e07.description: Seven hides the Doctor's program inside her cybernetic implants when holograms are outlawed, leaving him to experience physical life through her body while trying to escape.

s07e08.description: Kim accepts temporary command of a medical transport and quickly discovers that the refugees he agreed to help are involved in a far more dangerous conflict than they admitted.

s07e09-10.description: The Hirogen's sentient holographic prey revolt against their creators and seek the Doctor's help, forcing Voyager into a conflict over beings whose programmed suffering has become genuine.

s07e11.description: A temporal anomaly fractures Voyager into sections from different moments in its history, leaving Chakotay to move through the ship's past and future with a younger Janeway.

s07e12.description: Torres learns she is pregnant and becomes determined to alter her child's Klingon traits, forcing Paris to confront the childhood trauma driving her decision.

s07e13.description: Voyager transports condemned prisoners to an execution site, but the Doctor's treatment of one violent inmate raises troubling questions about guilt, rehabilitation and a justice system built around death.

s07e14.description: Voyager encounters a generational Klingon ship whose crew believes Torres's unborn child may fulfill an ancient prophecy that has guided their decades-long search.

s07e15.description: Voyager is trapped in a starless region where stranded ships survive by raiding one another, and Janeway tries to build cooperation instead of accepting the brutal local rules.

s07e16.description: Most of Voyager's crew are living contentedly as workers on an industrial planet with no memory of Starfleet, while the few who escaped try to discover how their identities were erased.

s07e17.description: Chakotay and the remaining free crew attempt to restore their shipmates' memories as Janeway resists abandoning the life she now believes is genuinely hers.

s07e18.description: Seven uses a holodeck simulation to practice intimacy and an ordinary social life, but her growing attachment to the fantasy begins interfering with her duties.

s07e19.description: Q leaves his reckless son in Janeway's care, hoping Starfleet discipline can teach the young omnipotent being responsibility before the Continuum passes judgment on him.

s07e20.description: The Doctor transmits a holonovel based on Voyager to the Alpha Quadrant, then fights for control of his work when the publisher treats both the program and its creator as property.

s07e21.description: Starfleet sends Voyager to retrieve an old Earth probe and the crew discovers a devastated civilization that blames humanity for the technology that poisoned its world.

s07e22.description: Seven and Chakotay crash inside an energy barrier protecting an isolated society, while Voyager's rescue efforts risk exposing the inhabitants to the outside world.

s07e23.description: Voyager finds a Talaxian community facing eviction from its asteroid home, forcing Neelix to decide whether his future still lies with the ship that became his family.

s07e24.description: The Doctor is coerced into impersonating members of Voyager's crew and stealing critical technology after aliens take Janeway hostage.

s07e25-26.description: A future Janeway returns with advanced technology and a dangerous plan to shorten Voyager's journey, bringing the crew into one final confrontation with the Borg on the road to Earth.
